news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reported Q2 2026 revenue of $5.8 million and a net loss of $81.1 million, and said the AMT-130 BLA for Huntington's disease remains on track for a Q3 2026 submission after the FDA confirmed alignment on the accelerated-approval pathway. Cash of $810.3 million (boosted by June's $259 million offering) is expected to fund operations into 2030, and the company plans to present four-year AMT-130 data on all 24 patients from the first two dose cohorts in September 2026; shares rose on the update.

news.headline: uniQure to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: uniQure confirmed it would report Q2 2026 financial results before market open on July 29, 2026, with a conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET. Analysts were looking for roughly $5.4 million in revenue and continued updates on the AMT-130 regulatory timeline.

news.headline: uniQure CEO Matthew Kapusta Sells Shares After Option Exercise Under 10b5-1 Plan
news.summary: CEO Matthew Kapusta exercised options for 21,082 shares at $19.39 and sold the same number at an average of $45.16 under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan, worth about $952,000, while uniQure's CMO sold 30,000 shares on June 30 under a similar plan. Around the same time, JPMorgan Chase disclosed a new Schedule 13G stake of roughly 7% of uniQure's outstanding shares, indicating a new passive institutional position.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Closing of Upsized Public Offering and Full Exercise by Underwriters of Option to Purchase Additional Shares
news.summary: uniQure closed an upsized underwritten public offering of 5,686,813 ordinary shares at $45.50 per share, including full exercise of the underwriters' option, raising roughly $259 million in gross proceeds. Proceeds are earmarked for AMT-130 commercialization readiness, the required confirmatory study, and other pipeline development, extending the company's cash runway into 2030.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Preliminary Data on the First Cohort in the Phase I/IIa Clinical Trial of AMT-260 in Refractory Mesial Temporal Lobe Epilepsy
news.summary: In the low-dose cohort (n=6) of the AMT-260 gene therapy trial for drug-resistant epilepsy, 3 of 6 patients showed 79-100% reductions in disabling seizures at months 4-6, with the therapy generally well tolerated and no serious treatment- or procedure-related adverse events. Enrollment in a higher-dose second cohort is ongoing, giving uniQure's pipeline a second clinical proof point beyond AMT-130.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Plan for BLA Submission for AMT-130 in Huntington's Disease
news.summary: Following a Type B meeting, the FDA agreed that uniQure's existing 3-year AMT-130 data (showing 75% slowing of cUHDRS progression versus external controls, P=.003) can support a Biologics License Application under the accelerated approval pathway, with submission planned for Q3 2026 alongside a parallel UK MHRA filing. The reversal from the FDA's earlier, more critical stance triggered a sharp stock rally and prompted several analysts, including H.C. Wainwright, to raise price targets on renewed confidence in AMT-130's approval path.

catalysts.label: FDA BLA submission for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Biologics License Application seeking accelerated approval of AMT-130 for Huntington's disease, after the FDA agreed that 3-year data can support the filing; reaffirmed as on track in the July 29, 2026 Q2 earnings update.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA marketing authorization application for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: In parallel with the US filing, uniQure plans to submit a Marketing Authorization Application to the UK's MHRA for AMT-130, following a constructive pre-submission meeting.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 four-year Phase I/II data presentation
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to present updated Phase I/II data including four years of follow-up on all 24 patients treated in the first two dose cohorts (12 high-dose, 12 low-dose), providing further support for the BLA package.

catalysts.label: Confirmatory study design finalization
catalysts.detail: uniQure is working with the FDA to finalize the design of the required post-approval confirmatory study for AMT-130, including possible use of a standard-of-care control arm instead of a sham procedure, ahead of or alongside the BLA submission.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 higher-dose cohort enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: Enrollment in the second, higher-dose cohort of the Phase I/IIa AMT-260 trial for refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy is expected to complete around mid-to-late 2026.

catalysts.label: Updated AMT-260 Phase I/IIa data readout
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to present updated safety and efficacy results, including higher-dose cohort data, from the ongoing AMT-260 epilepsy trial.

pulse: uniQure enters August 2026 on a high note: the FDA's June 17 reversal, agreeing that existing 3-year AMT-130 data can support an accelerated-approval BLA for Huntington's disease, sparked a sharp rally that carried through the July 29 Q2 2026 earnings report, which reaffirmed the Q3 2026 BLA and parallel UK MHRA filing timeline and revealed a fortified $810.3 million cash position (into 2030) after a $259 million equity offering closed in late June. Preliminary AMT-260 epilepsy data in June added a second pipeline catalyst, and analysts have broadly raised price targets on renewed confidence in AMT-130's path to market, even as routine insider selling under 10b5-1 plans and a new JPMorgan passive stake continued in the background. Investors now look to September 2026, when uniQure plans to present four-year data on all 24 patients from the first two AMT-130 dose cohorts, as the next major readout ahead of the actual BLA filing.
